sections.html: *Indicates Key Condition. This is not an exhaustive list of medical conditions.

nodes.d:
1. Age 6 mo to 6 yr
  2. Temp 38.5 C
  3. Neurologically normal exam before and after seizure

nodes.t: * If < 6 mo, not a febrile seizure → LP
nodes.d: * If < 6 mo, not a febrile seizure -> LP

nodes.t: * If neuro deficits or lethargic on exam need to rule out CNS infection → CT, LP
nodes.d: * If neuro deficits or lethargic on exam need to rule out CNS infection -> CT, LP

nodes.t: No investigations for seizure; work-up source of fever
nodes.d:
1. No Investigations for seizure
  2. Work-up source of fever (ear exam, consider urinalysis and culture, CBC)

nodes.t: Prognosis: 1/3 risk of future febrile seizure; no significant increased risk of epilepsy
nodes.d:
1. 1/3 risk of having future febrile seizure
  2. No significant increased risk of epilepsy
  3. No brain damage, no impact on intelligence

nodes.t: Prognosis: ~1/3 risk of future febrile seizure; slightly increased risk of epilepsy (4-6%)
nodes.d:
1. ~1/3 risk of having future febrile seizure
  2. Slightly increased risk of epilepsy (4-6%)
  3. No brain damage from short (<15 min) sz

nodes.t: EEG; consider CT/MRI; consider LP; work up source of fever
nodes.d:
1. EEG
  2. Consider CT/MRI, especially if focal features
  3. Consider LP (clinical decision; higher threshold to do LP if prolonged seizure, age 6-12 mo, or focal features)
  4. Work up source of fever
